title: Edge Robotics: Edge-Computing-Accelerated Multi-Robot Simultaneous Localization and Mapping

title: Edge Intelligence: On-Demand Deep Learning Model Co-Inference with Device-Edge Synergy

title: When2com: Multi-Agent Perception via Communication Graph Grouping
authors: Yen-Cheng Liu and Junjiao Tian and Nathaniel Glaser and Zsolt Kira

title: Where2comm: Communication-Efficient Collaborative Perception via Spatial Confidence Maps
authors: Yue Hu and Shaoheng Fang and Zixing Lei and Yiqi Zhong and Siheng Chen

title: Constrained Bandwidth Observation Sharing for Multi-Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments via Intelligent Knapsack
authors: Anirudh Chari and Rui Chen and Han Zheng and Changliu Liu

limitation: 假设基础上传占固定带宽，实验为ROS2/RMF仿真；本项目必须计入请求元数据及上传本身的成本。

title: Decentralized multi-robot exploration under low-bandwidth communications

title: Communication-Constrained Multi-Robot Exploration With Adaptive Communication Windows
authors: Ben Rossano and Jaein Lim and Jonathan P. How
contribution: MACE把是否值得主动会合通信纳入探索决策。
limitation: 依赖理想定位/地图对齐，主要是网格仿真；断续连接的会合代价与本项目AP拥塞不是同一问题。

title: MoRoCo: An Online Topology-Adaptive Framework for Multi-Operator Multi-Robot Coordination under Restricted Communication
authors: Zhuoli Tian and Yanze Bao and Yuyang Zhang and Meng Guo

limitation: 实机使用较重的激光/计算平台；其有界更新可达数分钟，不能混称毫秒级闭环。

title: Mobility-Budget-Constrained Submodular Maximization for Distributed Semantic Multi-Robot Exploration
authors: Changxuan Yao and Sandilya Sai Garimella and Lu Gan and Panagiotis Tsiotras
contribution: 联合考虑移动预算和语义信息收益，提醒通信优化仍须落实到任务收益。
limitation: 短篇与仿真结果；理论条件不直接覆盖低成本实体机器人。

authors: Tanja Katharina Kaiser and Marian Johannes Begemann and Tavia Plattenteich and Lars Schilling and Georg Schildbach and Heiko Hamann
status: ICRA 2022；arXiv上传2024，不能误写为2024新论文
read_level: 摘要、官方仓库README与许可证

title: SwarmUS: An open hardware and software on-board platform for swarm robotics development

title: A Hardware-Partitioned micro-ROS Mini-Vehicle for Operator-Supervised Neural Driving
authors: Gustavo Claudio Karl Couto and Eric Aislan Antonelo and Gabriel George Zipperer
read_level: 摘要、正文结构与实验段

title: Commerge: Communication-Efficient, Robust, and Fast LiDAR Map Merging Framework for Multi-Robot Coordination in Resource-Constrained Scenarios
authors: Hogyun Kim and Jiwon Choi and Juwon Kim and Geonmo Yang and Seokhwan Jeong and Hyungtae Lim and Younggun Cho

title: Advancing Multi-Robot Networks via MLLM-Driven Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Comprehensive Survey
authors: Hyun Jong Yang and Howon Lee and Kyuhong Shim and Jeongho Kwak and Hyunsoo Kim and Donghoon Kim and Khoa Anh Ngo and Sehyun Ryu and Jaehyun Choi and Youbin Kim and Chanjun Moon and Michael Ryoo and Byonghyo Shim
